title: Lantau morning, the Peak at sunset
call: Improving. Cloudy early, then mainly fine, 25 to 29°. The east wind is still force 6 at times on high ground early, so the 08:00 cable car check is the right move; it eases through the day. The Peak at sunset should be clear and fine.
src: 10%, AccuWeather until the Hong Kong Observatory 9-day forecast reaches Tue 27, from Mon 19
25° to 29°, cloudy early, then mainly fine, east force 4 to 5, 6 offshore and on high ground early
read: Cloudy early, then fine. Check the cable car at 08:00. Clear for the Peak.
tnote: Temperature shape estimated from the forecast high and low. Hourly temperatures fill in about 5 days out.
